title: Samsung's S90H OLED: Dazzling Visuals, Zero Glare, Right Price
summary: Samsung's new S90H 4K OLED TV builds on its acclaimed predecessor, delivering stunning picture quality with vibrant colors, deep contrast, and exceptional detail. Its standout matte screen technology effectively eliminates reflections, making it a versatile choice for any viewing environment, even brightly lit rooms.
content:
Last year, Samsung's S90F OLED TV set a high bar, captivating reviewers and consumers alike with its pitch-perfect blend of vibrant yet natural colors, astute image processing, and a contrast ratio so striking it made every scene pop. Now, its successor, the S90H 4K OLED, is here, and it’s not just upholding that legacy—it's elevating it, particularly for those who thought OLED brilliance always came with a side of glare.

Our extensive testing confirms the S90H truly delivers on its promise of an exceptional visual experience. The deep, inky blacks that only OLED can provide are here in full force, creating a sense of depth and realism that's genuinely immersive. Colors are rich and accurate, avoiding the oversaturation sometimes found in lesser displays, thanks to Samsung's refined processing engine that ensures every detail, from the subtlest shadow to the brightest highlight, is rendered with stunning clarity.

But the real game-changer, the feature that truly sets the S90H apart, is its revolutionary matte screen technology. This isn't just a minor tweak; it's a fundamental reimagining of the viewing experience. Gone are the frustrating reflections of ambient light or windows that plague glossy screens, even in brightly lit rooms. Whether you're watching a movie on a sunny afternoon or catching up on a show with lamps blazing, the S90H offers an uncompromised, reflection-free picture, making it a genuinely versatile centerpiece for virtually any living space.

Positioned shrewdly in the midrange OLED segment, the S90H offers a compelling proposition. It manages to package premium OLED performance with an innovative anti-glare solution, all while remaining accessible. For anyone seeking a top-tier cinematic experience without the typical OLED compromises of reflection, or the premium price tag, Samsung's S90H proves that high-end picture quality and everyday usability can, indeed, coexist beautifully.
keyTakeaways: The Samsung S90H delivers exceptional OLED picture quality, featuring vibrant, natural colors, deep contrast, and fantastic image processing for detailed visuals.
Its groundbreaking matte screen nearly eliminates reflections, making the TV highly adaptable and enjoyable in any room, regardless of lighting conditions.
Positioned as a strong midrange OLED, the S90H offers a premium viewing experience and innovative features at a competitive and accessible price point.
author: insider@insider.com (Ryan Waniata)
